controls.regle: The business use case (rationale, problem addressed, expected value) is formalized in a document validated by the business sponsor, prior to or concurrent with the project's start.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a scoping document (scoping note, mandate, pitch) describing the problem addressed and the expected value, and verify its formal validation by the business sponsor.
controls.preuve_attendue: Use case scoping document + proof of validation (signature, committee minutes, approval e-mail).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = scoping document exists and is validated by the sponsor ; partial = document exists but not formally validated ; non-compliant = no formalized use case
actions_audit: Request the use case scoping document and verify that it covers the rationale, the problem addressed, and the expected value.
Verify the trace of validation by the business sponsor (signature, minutes, e-mail).
If gap: have the use case formalized and organize its validation before continuing the technical audit.

controls.regle: The application's target users are identified and characterized by at least one documented persona per significant usage profile.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of persona sheets or an equivalent characterization (profile, needs, frequency of use, level of autonomy) for each significant user profile, and their consistency with actually observed users.
controls.preuve_attendue: Persona sheets or equivalent document + observed usage data (active users, frequency) if available.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = personas documented for all significant profiles and consistent with observed usage ; partial = partial personas or not compared against actual usage ; non-compliant = no documented persona
actions_audit: Request the persona sheets or equivalent user documentation; verify their coverage of usage profiles.
Compare the declared personas against actual usage data if available (active users, features used).
If gap: have the missing personas formalized based on representative user interviews.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase B (architecture métier, acteurs et rôles)

controls.regle: Structuring business rules (calculations, thresholds, business authorizations, special cases) are documented in a repository validated by the business, separate from the source code.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a business rules document covering the application's structuring rules, and its validation by a business representative; spot-check the consistency between documented rules and implemented rules.
controls.preuve_attendue: Validated business rules document (signed or pending signature) + code excerpts illustrating 2-3 rules for cross-checking.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = rules documented, validated, and consistent with the code on the sample checked ; partial = rules documented but not validated or partially consistent ; non-compliant = implicit business rules, known only from the code
actions_audit: Request the business rules document and verify its coverage of structuring cases and special cases.
Select a sample of rules and verify their consistency with the actual implementation (code, configuration).
If gap: have the rules repository completed/validated and correct the identified inconsistencies.
standards: COBIT 2019 — BAI02 (gérer la définition des exigences)

controls.regle: The application's expected value is translated into measurable business indicators (KPIs), each with a baseline value and a target.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of formalized business indicators with a calculation method, baseline value, and target, and verify that they are actually measured (dashboard, extraction, measurement log).
controls.preuve_attendue: Dashboard or KPI document with baseline and observed values + calculation method.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = KPIs defined, measured, with baseline and target ; partial = KPIs defined but not measured or without a baseline ; non-compliant = no business KPI defined
actions_audit: Request the list of business KPIs and their calculation method; verify the existence of a baseline value and a target.
Verify the freshness and reliability of the measurements produced (source, last update date).
If gap: have the missing KPIs defined and instrument their automated measurement.

controls.regle: The functional scope covered by the application is bounded by an explicit list of exclusions (out-of-scope items), communicated to stakeholders.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a documented list of functional out-of-scope items and its actual communication to stakeholders (sponsor, users, dependent teams).
controls.preuve_attendue: Scope document including an explicit out-of-scope section + proof of distribution (minutes, shared material).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = out-of-scope items documented and communicated ; partial = out-of-scope items documented but not distributed ; non-compliant = no explicit delineation of out-of-scope items
actions_audit: Request the scope documentation and verify the presence of an explicit out-of-scope section.
Verify that the out-of-scope items were communicated to and understood by the relevant stakeholders (quick interview).
If gap: have the list of scope exclusions formalized and distributed.
standards: TOGAF — ADM Phase A (délimitation du périmètre)

controls.regle: Product governance relies on a structured backlog, an explicit prioritization mechanism, and regular governance rituals (review, arbitration).
controls.verification: Verify the existence of an up-to-date product backlog, a documented prioritization method, and the actual holding of governance rituals (frequency, participants, tracked decisions).
controls.preuve_attendue: Product backlog excerpt + prioritization method + minutes of governance rituals over a representative period.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = structured backlog, documented prioritization, rituals held and tracked ; partial = backlog exists without a prioritization method or irregular rituals ; non-compliant = no backlog or product governance
actions_audit: Request access to the product backlog and verify its structure (status, priority, value).
Verify that product governance rituals were held over recent periods (minutes, decisions).
If gap: recommend implementing a structured backlog and a regular prioritization ritual.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion du portefeuille

controls.regle: The application's business value is demonstrated by measured results (adoption, gains, return on investment), not merely projected.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of measured results (actual usage, qualitative/quantitative gains, user feedback) and their comparison against the initial value hypotheses.
controls.preuve_attendue: Value assessment (measured results vs. initial hypotheses) + observed usage or gains data.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = value demonstrated by measured results compared against the initial hypotheses ; partial = initial results available but incomplete or not compared against the hypotheses ; non-compliant = value only projected, no measured result
actions_audit: Request the value assessment and the usage or gains data observed since release.
Compare the measured results against the value hypotheses formulated at the outset.
If gap: have value measurement organized (instrumentation, user survey) before the industrialization decision.

controls.regle: Critical functional journeys (those whose failure would compromise business value) are formalized and validated with representative users.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a formalization of the critical journeys (storyboard, user journey, process) and their validation by representative users or the business.
controls.preuve_attendue: Formalized functional journey document + proof of user validation (test, workshop, documented feedback).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = critical journeys formalized and validated by representative users ; partial = journeys formalized in fragments or not validated ; non-compliant = critical journeys not documented
actions_audit: Identify the critical functional journeys with the business and request their existing formalization.
Verify the trace of a validation by representative users (workshop, test, feedback collected).
If gap: have the missing critical journeys formalized and validated before the industrialization decision.

controls.regle: The project's structuring assumptions and business risks are recorded in a living register, with a mitigation plan for each significant risk.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a register of business assumptions and risks, its recent update, and the presence of a mitigation plan for significant risks.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated register of business assumptions/risks + mitigation plan associated with significant risks.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = register up to date with mitigation plans for all significant risks ; partial = register exists but not updated or partial mitigation ; non-compliant = no register of business assumptions or risks
actions_audit: Request the register of business assumptions and risks and verify its last update date.
Verify the existence of a mitigation plan for each risk rated as significant.
If gap: have the register established and prioritize the missing mitigation plans.
